title: Taxing the Heat Out of the U.S. Food System
Economics of Optimal Reservoir Capacity Determination, Sediment Management, and Dam Decommissioning
Climate Change and Land Use in Southeastern U.S.: Did the 'Dumb Farmer' Get It Wrong?
abstract: The assumption of a fixed amount of land remaining in agriculture regardless of changing climate conditions — one of the features of the “dumb farmer scenario” — is likely to bias the estimated social welfare impacts of climate change. In order to quantify this bias, we employ a demand-supply framework to determine both the amount of land allocated to agricultural and nonagricultural uses as well as the social welfare associated with this allocation choice when no market distortions exist. We present an application of our model to the Southeastern United States and simulate the effects of changing climate conditions on land allocation in the region between 2007 and 2040. We find a very modest welfare bias when maintaining current farmland preservation policies and a more substantial bias if we assume that additional land policies are instituted which have spillover welfare effects in other land-using sectors.
abstract_zh: “固定农地面积”假设，即无论气候条件如何变化，农业用地面积都保持不变，这是“笨农民情景”的特征之一，它可能会使对气候变化社会福利影响的估计产生偏差。为量化这种偏差，我们采用供需框架，在不存在市场扭曲的情况下，确定用于农业和非农业用途的土地面积，以及该土地配置选择所对应的社会福利。我们将模型应用于美国东南部，模拟了2007至2040年间气候条件变化对该地区土地配置的影响。我们发现，在维持现行农地保护政策的情况下，偏差非常小；而如果假设还实施了会对其他土地利用部门产生溢出福利效应的额外土地政策，偏差则更为显著。

title: Upstream Water Resource Management to Address Downstream Pollution Concerns: A Policy Framework with Application to the Nakdong River Basin in South Korea
The External Impact of Agriculture on Inland Wetlands: A Case Study from Argentina
On the Natural and Economic Difficulties to Fulfilling the Human Right to Water Within a Neoclassical Economics Framework
abstract: We present a neoclassical economic model of the human right to water using a nonrenewable resource model inclusive of a backstop technology. The right is interpreted as a minimum consumption requirement the government is obligated to fulfill in the event that any one household cannot do so independently. Differing by income levels, households maximize utility by purchasing a composite consumption good and water from two distinct, government-owned sources. Facing physical and financial constraints, the government uses fiscal policy to address potential human rights violations. Reducing the analysis to two periods, we develop a novel approach to compare total welfare levels from a joint human rights and neoclassical economics perspective. We define a human rights welfare standard and discuss cases in which traditional social welfare measures would exceed, violate, or meet this standard. We thus offer a unique way to merge economic analysis with human rights research.
abstract_zh: 我们运用包含后备技术的不可再生资源模型，提出了水的人权的新古典经济学模型。该权利被解释为：当任何一户家庭无法独立满足时，政府有义务实现的最低消费要求。不同收入水平的家庭通过购买综合消费品，以及从两个不同的政府所有水源购买水，以实现效用最大化。面对实物和财政约束，政府运用财政政策来应对潜在的人权侵犯。我们将分析简化为两期，从人权与新古典经济学相结合的视角，提出了一种比较总福利水平的新方法。我们定义了人权福利标准，并讨论了传统社会福利指标可能超过、违背或符合该标准的情形。因此，我们提供了一种将经济分析与人权研究相融合的独特方式。

title: Optimal Watershed Management for Reservoir Sustainability: An Economic Appraisal
venue: Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management
abstract: Accumulation of sediment from upstream agricultural land may shorten the lifetime of a reservoir and reduce its long-term benefits. This paper presents a framework for assessment of management strategies that simultaneously considers upstream soil conservation and downstream reservoir-level sediment control. A dynamic model that utilizes optimal control theory is developed for this purpose. Simulation results from the model are expected to provide practical information for policy makers, such as determination of the best sediment removal technology, the optimal timing to install this technology, and the optimal pattern of soil conservation efforts. An illustrative application to Lake Aswan, which is located between the Sudan and Egypt, indicates that the highest permissible level of soil conservation and the unconstrained dredging installed at 22 years are the best management practices, giving a sustainable life of the reservoir and net benefits of $117.8 billion. The cooperative strategy compared to the noncooperative and baseline strategies increases social net benefits by $6.5 billion and $7.8 billion, respectively. To test the robustness of this study’s results, sensitive analysis for key parameters, such as interest rate, water price, agricultural sediment contribution, and soil conservation effectiveness was performed. The results are very sensitive to selected parameters. As suspected, interest rate and water price shift the net present value of watershed on both sides. However, the rank of alternatives does not change.
abstract_zh: 上游农业用地的泥沙积累可能缩短水库寿命，并减少其长期效益。本文提出了一个框架，用于评估同时考虑上游水土保持和下游水库层面泥沙控制的管理策略。为此，我们建立了一个运用最优控制理论的动态模型。模型的模拟结果有望为政策制定者提供实用信息，例如确定最佳的泥沙清除技术、安装该技术的最优时机，以及最优的水土保持努力模式。文章以位于苏丹和埃及之间的阿斯旺湖为例进行说明，结果表明，最高允许水平的水土保持与在第22年安装的无约束疏浚，是最佳管理实践，可使水库保持可持续寿命，并带来1178亿美元的净效益。与非合作策略和基准策略相比，合作策略分别使社会净效益增加65亿美元和78亿美元。为检验研究结果的稳健性，我们对利率、水价、农业泥沙来源以及水土保持效果等关键参数进行了敏感性分析。结果对所选参数非常敏感。正如预期，利率和水价使流域的净现值向两个方向移动，但各方案的排序并未改变。

Control of Stationary and Mobile Source Air Pollution: Reducing Emissions of Hydrocarbons for Ozone Abatement in Connecticut
abstract: Both stationary and mobile sources are major contributors to many air quality problems. Typically, regulators have more control over total emissions from stationary sources, but only control emissions per vehicle mile from mobile sources, taking total vehicle miles of travel (VMT) as given. A cost minimization model is developed to compare emissions control policies which reduce VMT, to other prevailing stationary and mobile source emission control strategies. Connecticut data for the ground-level ozone problem is used to show that controlling VMT, through an optimally determined gasoline tax, will marginally reduce total social costs of Connecticut's emission control program.
abstract_zh: 固定源和移动源都是许多空气质量问题的主要来源。通常，监管机构能够较好地控制固定源的总排放量，但对移动源则只能控制每车英里的排放，并将总车辆行驶里程（VMT）视为给定。本文建立了一个成本最小化模型，用于比较减少车辆行驶里程的排放控制政策与其他现行的固定源和移动源排放控制策略。以康涅狄格州地面臭氧问题的数据为例，结果表明，通过最优确定的汽油税来控制车辆行驶里程，将略微降低康涅狄格州排放控制计划的总社会成本。

Technology Adoption in the Presence of an Exhaustible Resource: The Case of Groundwater Extraction
abstract: In this paper we integrate technology diffusion within Hotelling's exhaustible resource model. The modern technology is a conservation technology such as drip irrigation used with groundwater. Resource quality heterogeneity and rising water prices are responsible for the gradual adoption of the modern technology, and under reasonable conditions the diffusion curve is an S‐shaped function of time. Without intervention, the diffusion process will be slower than is socially optimal, and optimal resource use tax will accelerate the diffusion of the conservation technology and slow down excessive resource depletion caused by market failure due to open access conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文将技术扩散纳入霍特林的可耗竭资源模型。现代技术是一种节水技术，例如与地下水配合使用的滴灌。资源质量的异质性和不断上涨的水价，导致现代技术逐步被采用；在合理条件下，扩散曲线是时间的S形函数。若无干预，扩散过程将慢于社会最优水平；而最优资源使用税可以加速节水技术的扩散，并减缓因开放获取条件下的市场失灵而导致的过度资源耗竭。

title: Amenity Benefits and the Optimal Allocation of Land
Changes in Water Allocation Mechanisms for California Agriculture
abstract:
Existing institutions allocating water in California reflect prior appropriation water rights established when water was abundant. These allocation rules queue users and do not encourage water conservation. Increased water scarcity and growing valuation of water's environmental benefits are inducing a transition to water allocation mechanisms that increase water efficiency in agriculture. Transferable rights systems will lead to market‐like water allocation, induce farmers to adopt water conservation technology, and may not face strong objection from senior water rights holders. One must weigh the efficiency gains associated with transition from water rights to water markets against the transaction costs associated with installing facilities that enable water exchange and trading.
Transition to water markets may preserve the agricultural sector's well‐being while allowing the transfer of some water outside of agriculture—in particular, for environmental benefit. The cost of policies proposed to reduce agricultural water supply while encouraging water trading are inversely related to the extent of trading allowed. The more farmers trade water, the less costly reducing water supply is to agriculture. Policies reducing water supply to Central Valley Project contractors and allowing trading only among these contractors are much more expensive than are policies encouraging trading among all agricultural water users in California.
abstract_zh:
加州现行的水资源分配制度反映了在水量充裕时期确立的先占水权。这些分配规则使用水者排队等候，且不鼓励节水。日益加剧的水资源稀缺，以及对水的环境效益日益增长的重视，正推动着向提高农业用水效率的水分配机制转型。可转让权利体系将导向类市场化的水分配，促使农民采用节水技术，并且可能不会遭到资深水权持有者的强烈反对。必须权衡从水权制度转向水市场所带来的效率收益，与建设水交易所需设施的交易成本。
向水市场转型可能维持农业部门的福利，同时允许部分水资源转移到农业以外，特别是用于环境效益。旨在减少农业供水同时鼓励水交易的政策成本，与所允许的交易范围呈反向关系。农民交易水的程度越高，减少供水对农业的成本就越低。仅向中央河谷工程（Central Valley Project）承包商减少供水，并仅允许这些承包商之间交易的政策，远比鼓励加州所有农业用水者之间交易的政策昂贵。

title: A Water Scarcity or a Water Management Crisis?
abstract: This paper suggests that we have a water management crisis rather than a water availability problem in the western United States and that, with creative policy reforms, we may obtain much more from the water we have already. It develops a methodology to assess the economics of adoption of modern irrigation technologies (drip, sprinkler), shows that adoption of these technologies may lead to yield increases and water saving, and argues that low water prices are the cause for low adoption levels. It is demonstrated that a transition from the current water rights system to water markets will increase the price of water, lead to adoption of modern irrigation technologies, and generate sufficient water reserves to accommodate the growing demand for water in the nonagricultural sectors.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，在美国西部，我们面临的是水资源管理危机，而非水资源可获得性问题；通过创造性的政策改革，我们或许能从现有水资源中获得更多收益。本文提出了一种评估现代灌溉技术（滴灌、喷灌）采用经济性的方法，表明采用这些技术可能带来产量提高和节水，并认为低水价是采用率较低的原因。研究表明，从现行水权制度向水市场过渡，将提高水价，促使现代灌溉技术得到采用，并产生足够的水储备，以满足非农业部门日益增长的用水需求。
